new_results.name: QFORM-HEAVY-ROW-PAIR-CAP-v1
new_results.statement: For orthonormal v,q, V=v.X, H=(beta v+m q).X and physical row leverage c=v_r^2+q_r^2>0, ||p_(V,H)||_infinity <= sqrt(e)/(m sqrt(c)), stable at c=1 and independent of h_r=beta v_r+m q_r.

new_results.name: QFORM-PAIRCAP-FRESNEL-L2-v1
new_results.statement: For Q=a^{-1}H^2+2 sigma U V with true scalar cap L and right-pair joint cap M, |phi_Q(t)| <= min(1, pi sqrt(LM/|sigma|)/|t|), ||p_Q||_2^2 <=2 sqrt(LM/|sigma|), and int |t|^{-1/2}|phi_Q|^2 <=(16/3)sqrt(pi)(LM/|sigma|)^{1/4}.

new_results.name: QFORM-PAIRCAP-FINITE-LP-HALFRIESZ-v1
new_results.statement: For p>=2, ||p_Q||_p <= [p sqrt(LM/|sigma|)]^{1-1/p}; hence sup_z E|Q-z|^{-1/2} <= [6sqrt(6)/2^{2/3}](LM/|sigma|)^{1/4}. A further genuine disjoint square d[Z+h]^2 gives an L-infinity bound with the same half-Riesz factor times |d|^{-1/2}.
